judge: Claude Code subagent, Claude Opus 5.5, fresh
critique: The ambient barks (the tongue stuck to the railing, 'A black day indeed!', the panicky shopkeeper) catch Nox's short comic town chatter well. But a snowbound garrison town and a quest for magic fur shears don't match any Nox campaign map, and the 'token of my appreciation' reward line feels formulaic.
